Reconciled the historical reading estimate with creation, modification and source-rebuild requirements in the [study](../docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.md) and [evidence JSON](../docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.json).
The old 33–99 versus 89–264 engineer-day figures assume an unverified 8.0–2025 range and omit writing; no full-goal total, meaningful ratio or fallback decision is supported.
The comparison covers native/control/type artifacts, XML project/library/class/build definitions, packages/distributions and module/target variants without narrowing scope.
Eight cost drivers separate shared reading from incremental writing, units, dependencies, version variation and unsupported ranges; unknown costs remain null.
Original save version, emitted editing format and validation runtime are distinct, with independent preservation and native-check requirements.
The unsuccessful POC supplies blockers, not impossibility; #493 clears its synthetic design only. No native execution, benchmark run, writer or readiness claim was made.
Starting commit `058c3abf6be57eca65394a6c2500a95ded2b26e3`, tree `c1e21ef789a7bac6701f01437068fa97a2031237`; initially clean tracked worktree.
Required output-shape verification passed (exit 0); independent hash checks matched all 25 sources and confirmed all 14 used tracked inputs unchanged from the starting commit.
Only the two requested repository outputs were added; historical study, POC and benchmark inputs remain unchanged. Parent commits; no commit was run.

Acceptance limitation: `.session/loop-state.json` is absent and selected history has zero records; committed goal comparison is saved, but live-goal parity cannot be verified.
## What next
The one ready follow-up is a bounded WM1-original version-evidence audit; its prepared input pin was verified, and JSON records exact inputs, observable result and stop condition.
That audit narrows an unknown input version; decisive semantic encoding/integrity uncertainty requires controlled same-version evidence and later provisioned native checks, neither currently staged.
Resume from these outputs and saved POC limits; independently review the estimate before a fallback proposal. Avoid corpus searches, closed reviews, assumed version-field authority, owner-silence acceptance and unavailable native experiments.
